predictor.notes: Best-supported reconstruction for integer quantities 1..1000, in GBP pence: three affine tiers, with marginal prices changing after quantities 202 and 570. Matches all 144 distinct exact REA observations, including approved quantities 50 and 200, with zero-cent error. The model matched 110 additional validation quantities after identification; checks included adjacent quantities around both transitions, local curvature tests, and domain-wide gap probes. No gap between sampled quantities exceeds 10. Least-squares and fixed-start interval fitting support these coefficients; no quadratic terms or additional segments were needed. Confidence is high, conditional on no unobserved exceptional pricing rules: finite sampling cannot exclude isolated deviations or narrow regimes entirely between sampled quantities.
